messages:
Maya C.: Hey team — kicking off the onboarding for Meridian Health. Quick thread to align stakeholders, success criteria, and the first-14d timeline. @Arjun @Leah @Tom can you confirm availability for a 30m kickoff tomorrow?
Arjun P.: available 10:30am PT or 2pm PT. prefer 10:30.
Leah S.: can do 10:30 on my end. will invite the product champion (Elena) and infra lead (Jae).
Tom R.: 10:30 works. want to ensure we surface renewal risks early — usage targets and integration blockers.
Maya C.: perfect. agenda I'm thinking: 1) success criteria 2) integration checklist 3) monitoring & health cadence 4) feedback capture plan. short and actionable.
onboarding-bot: Meeting created: Meridian Health Kickoff — Tue 10:30am PT — calendar link: https://calendar.example/meet/meridian-kickoff
Arjun P.: for success criteria, propose: - Prod traffic pilot by D+14 (10k tokens/day) - Embeddings sync for search by D+10 - No P1s in first 30 days. thoughts?
Leah S.: agree. add: onboarding enablement completed for 4 SME users (train-the-trainer) by D+7.
Tom R.: renewal-risk signals to track: slow uptake (<30% of expected calls by D+14), persistent latency >200ms p50 for generation, repeated model-quality regressions. we should map owners for each signal.
Maya C.: owners: Arjun -> infra & perf; Leah -> enablement & customer training; Tom -> success metrics & renewal flags.
Arjun P.: I'll scope infra readouts and provide expected pre-prod runbook. I'll drop a short checklist here before the meeting.
Arjun P.: ```
INFR A QUICK CHECK (D0-D7):
- VPN/VPC peering verified
- API keys scoped & RBAC done
- Test corpus uploaded
- Latency smoke tests (p50/p95)
```
Leah S.: adding enablement checklist: ```
ENABLEMENT (D0-D10):
- 1:1s scheduled with champion
- Training deck shared + recording
- 4 SME sandbox users created
- Feedback survey (qual + NPS) sent after week 1
```
Maya C.: Nice. For feedback capture, let's do a short 6-question survey + 2 open prompts. Leah can own survey, Tom will own analysis & flags.
Tom R.: will set up a lightweight dashboard: weekly active users, avg tokens/session, error rate, NPS score. I'll add a simple alert when any metric breaches threshold.
Maya C.: Risk mitigation plan: if uptake low, we'll run a 3-day adoption push (office hours + targeted enablement). If perf issues, fallback routing to smaller model variant for traffic bursts.
Leah S.: can we schedule an enablement drop-in on D+3? 30m Q&A for SMEs.
Maya C.: yes — D+3 11am PT. I'll create calendar invite and onboarding playbook in the shared drive.
Maya C.: Action items after this thread: 1) Arjun: infra runbook + smoke test artifact (due D+1) 2) Leah: training deck + survey (due D+5) 3) Tom: dashboard skeleton + alert thresholds (due D+4) 4) Maya: invites + shared drive docs (done)
Arjun P.: noted. I'll post runbook link in this thread once done.
Leah S.: I'll import the training deck template from our CS templates folder and tailor. link coming.
Tom R.: ping me once runbook is up, I'll wire the dashboard to staging metrics.
Maya C.: ok team — thanks. quick ask for stakeholder list so I can cc them: Elena (prod champion), Jae (infra), Priya (legal), Omar (security). anyone else?
Leah S.: add Sara (data ops) and Ben (customer support).
Maya C.: great. I'll include them on invites. Recording + notes will be posted under: https://drive.example/r/meridian-onboard.
Maya C.: if anything urgent before the meeting, DM me. otherwise see you 10:30am PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
